question: Does increasing Mirror functional complexity improve seed stability and heldout quality, independently of early routing protection?
scope: CPU two-expert synthetic nonlinear regression; not GIC001 reproduction, not LLM or sparse runtime claim
optimizer: Adam, betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8, foreach=False, no weight decay; LR multiplied by .1 at step 375

routing.free: random linear sigmoid from context and input; init std .3, bias std .3
routing.equal: zero router weights/bias, free training immediately
routing.warm: zero router and constant half-half forward for first125 steps, free thereafter
routing.oracle: true latent mode hard gate, diagnostic only

initialization: separate generators for shared weights, codes and router. Codes are nonzero .1 Gaussian; same first coordinates and parent for nested capacities. Independent experts start at identical shared weights plus fixed .01 independent perturbation.
calibration: choose one common LR minimizing mean across methods/families/train_counts of final validation MSE divided by mean squared validation label; no test metric used
primary_endpoint: step500 clean heldout MSE and worst latent regime MSE, raw final checkpoint. Best-validation checkpoint separately reported. Regime IDs are diagnostic only except oracle.
seed_unit: 8 independent initialization triples within each of5 independently generated worlds. World is primary replication unit. Mini-batch order fixed within each world so not confounded with initialization.

H_capacity.pass: mean test MSE <=.95x and worst-regime <=1.01x in >=4/5 worlds within a family/train_count

H_stability.pass: within-world initialization variance <=.70x AND mean <=1.01x AND worst-regime <=1.01x in >=4/5 worlds

H_specificity.pass: mean <=.95x and worst-regime <=1.01x in >=4/5 worlds, identical parameter counts; report actual bytes and runtime separately

overfit: clean test minus clean train MSE at fixed endpoint; final versus validation-selected endpoints. Both descriptive, no post-hoc gate.
causal_boundary: No claim of lock-in from seed variance/correlation alone. Compare same initial parent+code under routing interventions; oracle route is not a natural performance baseline.
mechanism_diagnostics: mean soft usage, near-starvation<.05 mean usage, functional expert difference on identical inputs, permutation-invariant regime alignment, actual expert-contribution shared-parameter gradient norms/cosines at start and end
storage: deterministic uncompressed FP32 inference file with explicit metadata and every tensor; training batched across independent replicas, serialized individually. No free code or expanded-weight cache.
fresh_gate: implementation/numerical integrity, not positive development performance. All frozen comparisons are completed or explicitly marked incomplete; no sequential significance stopping.
external_validity: aligned teacher favors exact Mirror family; unrelated teacher tests mismatch. No planted delayed-payoff mechanism. 5 worlds and8 inits give limited variance precision; no cross-task universal conclusion.
